script: Imagine an ancient creature, trapped in stone for 345 million years, holding a secret that baffled scientists for decades. What if everything they thought they knew about it was completely wrong? For over a century, this fossil, discovered in Montana, was simply classified as a primitive fish. A humble swimmer, blending into the primordial seas, a distant relative to modern aquatic life. But a new study just blew that idea out of the water! Researchers re-examined the fossil and identified it not as a fish, but as a brand-new species of gigantic, venomous sea scorpion. This incredible discovery completely rewrites the history books. It reveals a powerful, previously unknown predator dominating ancient oceans, proving that even our oldest scientific understandings can hold breathtaking surprises.
